author: Evan A.
review: Wow so good!! The tofu was fried perfectly and the teriyaki had great flavor with some insane portions! Fried rice was seasoned perfectly too.

author: Bobby S.
review: I ordered the C17 teriyaki chicken with a wok special. I decided on Mongolian beef.. it was good and fresh.

author: Simon K.
review: After a round of golf, we stopped by Ginger Teriyaki in Auburn and had a wonderful meal. We ordered the shrimp fried rice and chicken teriyaki, and everything was fresh, flavorful, and delicious.

author: M (Local Reviewer)
review: Loved the chicken katsu that I just demolished! The katsu had good flavor, katsu sauce is solid with a little sweetness and tang. Overall, the food, homey feeling, and sweet auntie and uncle running the show makes this place a winner.

author: Teresa E.
review: Wow! We absolutely loved the food and the amounts are amazing for the price, we both had take-home lunch for the next day! The staff was super friendly!

author: Kayls
review: Reasonable price, quick preparation, and wonderful food. Our new favorite place!

author: Keith
review: Absolutely love this place. Finally being able to get amazing food again after moving here from Seattle. Been so happy with the new place and everything its menu has to offer.

author: Casandra Q.
review: The food is delicious and pricing was pretty reasonable. Be aware that even when I chose mild for heat, it was a bit much for my kids. Otherwise overall would eat here again.

author: Estella
review: Delicious and such huge servings! The crab Rangoon is to die for. Next time I'm trying the honey garlic chicken which sounds amazing.

author: Tammy S.
review: First time trying this spot and it was absolutely delicious! Everything came out hot and fresh.

author: Bethany
review: Our go-to weeknight take out spot. Quick service, great food, and always consistent!

author: Kelcey
review: Amazing. So good! The chicken teriyaki sauce is the perfect balance of sweet and savory.

author: David L.
review: The dining room and tables are clean and comfortable. The portions are large and satisfying. Highly recommend the family combos.

author: Marcus T.
review: Best lunch spot in the area. The fried rice is the best I've had in Auburn. Quick service if you are on a lunch break.

author: Sarah M.
review: A delightful gem that promises an authentic experience. This cozy restaurant, run by a charming couple, offers a warm and inviting atmosphere.

author: Chris P.
review: The food came out streaming hot. Portions were incredibly generous, and the taste of the beef teriyaki was excellent.

author: Jessica H.
review: The egg flower soup is a delightful experience. Perfect for a rainy day alongside a big plate of spicy chicken teriyaki.

author: Jason B.
review: The food portions here are large and definitely worth every cent. They don't skimp on the meat like other teriyaki shops.

author: Amanda R.
review: Super homey Japanese ambience and friendly service from the owners. They treat you like family the second you walk in.

author: Ryan K.
review: Their lunch specials provide incredible value. It's perfectly suited for casual meals or a quick family outing.
